description:
## Symptom
`fixtures2/00430_opaque_value_accessor.fz` fails on run, interp and build with `function_clause`. Reduction: `@type t :: opaque any`; `def get(h :: t), do: :ok`; `main` calls `A.get(1)`, and it fails the same way.

## Mechanism
`resolve.rs:157-160` publishes an opaque type as `opaque_of(tag)`, a bare tag, and drops the inner type. `dispatch_reachability.rs:136-184` intersects the argument with the tag and gets empty, so `executable_facts.rs:487-501` materializes zero clauses.

## Elixir (`../elixir` 759443e72)
`@opaque` is typespec metadata only (`typespecs.md:241`). The value is its structure. Only Dialyzer enforces opacity.

## Approved design (../fz-xxd.7.html)
- The `NominalKind::Opaque` arm in resolve.rs mints `mint_brand(inner, tag)`, exactly as `Refines` does.
- `note_protocol_domain_type` (source_publish.rs:1866-1882) uses a new `NominalKind::ProtocolDomain`, which resolves to the bare domain tag as today. No `is_protocol_domain_type` guard is added to resolve.
- `OpaqueTag::Named(String)` becomes `OpaqueTag::ProtocolDomain(ModuleName)`. `protocol_domain_tag` / `is_protocol_domain_tag` string encoding and the string-taking `opaque_of` go.
- Delete (no production callers): `mint_owned_resource_aliases` (trait, impl, descr helper); `check_opaque_visibility`, the `VisibilityTypes` trait, `check_brand_mint_visibility`, `OpaqueVisibilityError`, src/types/visibility.rs, visibility_test.rs; and `opaque_owner_module` if nothing else uses it.
- BuiltinOpaque and OpaqueTag::ProtocolTarget are unchanged.
- Docs: set-theoretic-types.md (the "Brands carry their inner; opaques are nominal tags" section), type-naming.md, and guides/ where they describe opaque. The one-brand limit (`opaque utf8` replaces the utf8 brand) is written down.
- Hiding the structure outside the module is fz-xxd.8.

## Done when
- 00430 and the reduction run on run/interp/build. 00431 gets a main and stays clean. Both move to fixtures/ and their tests leave port_planner_test.rs.
- Lattice test: opaque-over-integer <: integer, and not the reverse.
- The protocol dispatch pins (contract_test.rs, drive_test.rs) are unchanged.
title: An opaque-typed parameter admits no value, so its clause is unreachable
